corrections.observed_by: backend/scripts/generate_generic_tier_a_fixtures.py (offline, 0 model calls), before any browser run
corrections.root_cause: The first registration copied the topology_kernel expectation of the six older families. Their negatives run the deterministic compiler (GEOMETRY_COMPILER_MODE=DETERMINISTIC_FIRST), whose eligibility check is the only producer of NON_POSITIVE_LENGTH (app/simulation/geometry_compiler/compiler.py). The regular square pyramid is not a compiler family; its fixtures run the default LLM_ONLY route, where the zero base edge reaches the kernel and is refused at execution (GEOMETRY_OPERAND_TYPE: coincident base vertices).
corrections.why_not_a_product_fix_in_w1: The refusal is fail-closed (no answer, no scene). The six older families take the same path on the default route; only their fixtures use the compiler. Adding a source-level non-positive check to the LLM_ONLY route changes every family and is outside the W1 scope.
corrections.open_limit: On the default route a text that states a zero length is refused with cause UNKNOWN, so the learner is not told the text is at fault. Recorded as an open limit in HANDOFF.md, not hidden.
corrections.note: The corpus labels (diagnostics/corpus/LABELS.json) are unchanged; this negative is a browser-suite fixture outside the corpus.
